body.p: Secrets (variables with secretly stored values) are created and configured in the Secrets preferences page. To access this page, and go to Secrets.
The values for each secret variable are stored by encrypted for your specific user account and can be expanded using the editor variable ${secret(PARAM_NAME)}.

This preferences page displays a table of all the secret variables that have been defined. The table includes two columns for the editor variable: Name and its secret Value.The Secrets preferences page cannot be stored at Project level and shared with other users.

You can expand secrets using the specific ${secret(PARAM_NAME)} editor variable in various places in and in installed add-ons (for example, in the Model Context Protocol configuration files for the AI Positron add-on in places where access tokens need to be provided).
